---
name: interactive-options
description: >
  Render decision points as clickable options the user can pick.
  Trigger: When asking the user to choose among 2-6 alternatives. When proposing next steps that need confirmation.
---
Use the Claude Code Form API. Emit one option per choice with a short label
and a one-line description. Default selection: option 1.


## Rules

- Use the skill only when the answer space is finite (2-6 mutually exclusive choices).
- Skip the skill for binary yes/no questions — handle inline.
